task: Get ready to pick stuff up and put it in places, because you've just entered TextWorld! First off, make an effort to head south. Then, try to take a trip east. With that accomplished, go north. That done, attempt to take a trip east. That done, take the cauliflower from the couch within the playroom. And once you've done that, you win!
description:
You are in a vault. It seems to be pretty typical here.



There is an unguarded exit to the east. You need an unblocked exit? You should try going north. You need an unblocked exit? You should try going south.

summary: I am in the vault.
thought: I should go south as the first step.
feedback:
Guess what, you are in the place we're calling the spare room.

You hear a noise behind you and spin around, but you can't see anything other than a suitcase. You can see a rack. What a coincidence, weren't you just thinking about a rack? The rack is standard. But oh no! there's nothing on this piece of trash. What, you think everything in TextWorld should have stuff on it?

You don't like doors? Why not try going east, that entranceway is unguarded. There is an exit to the north. Don't worry, it is unguarded.
